decision_reason: Iteration 1 returned strong coverage of CDC outbreak investigation pages and some FDA/news sources, but several important gaps remain for the specific May–July 2024 window: (1) The most directly relevant outbreak — Backyard Poultry May 2024 — was found but its hospitalization and death counts are not visible in the snippet; the index/summary page (not just the investigation update) needs to be surfaced. (2) The Fresh Basil April 2024 outbreak snippet shows no case counts — it may have illness dates extending into May 2024. (3) No CDC outbreak pages specifically dated May, June, or July 2024 (other than Backyard Poultry) have been surfaced — there may be additional outbreaks (e.g., linked to cantaloupes, onions, or other vehicles) active in that window. (4) FDA recall/advisory pages for May–July 2024 Salmonella events have not been individually surfaced (only 3 fda.gov results appeared, none with visible case counts in snippets). (5) FSIS/USDA appeared once but without case-count detail. (6) State-level subnational data (cases_probable, cases_suspected, locality) is still absent. (7) The CDC 2024 multistate outbreak summary page was found but its per-outbreak breakdown for May–July needs targeted follow-up. Iteration 2 should: (a) target CDC outbreak index pages specifically for May–July 2024 vehicles not yet surfaced; (b) target FDA advisories with case counts for that window; (c) target Food Safety News and CIDRAP for state-level and hospitalization detail; (d) use the CDC 2024 summary page as a pivot to find individual outbreak pages active in the window.

decision_reason: Two full iterations have been executed, reaching the max_iterations bound of 2. The accumulated candidate set provides sufficient coverage across the primary target fields for the May–July 2024 window. Key in-window outbreaks are represented by authoritative CDC pages and corroborated by CIDRAP: (1) Backyard Poultry – May 2024 (470 confirmed cases, 1 death, 48 states, illness onset Jan–Sep 2024, fully within window); (2) Cucumbers – June 2024 (CDC index page surfaced, Salmonella Braenderup, Florida grower, recall issued); (3) Eggs – September 2024 (illness onset from May 23, 2024, 93 cases, 34 hospitalizations, 0 deaths, 12 states — in-window illness onset confirmed); (4) FoodNet 2024 Preliminary Data (annual surveillance totals for Salmonella including hospitalizations and deaths); (5) CDC 2024 multistate outbreak summary (38 Salmonella outbreaks in 2024 context); (6) CIDRAP articles providing corroborating case counts, hospitalization figures, and the 1 death in Illinois for the backyard poultry outbreak. The Cucumbers June 2024 index page (africana-06-24) was a new, non-duplicate find in iteration 2 that directly fills the June 2024 gap. The CIDRAP egg-linked article provides illness onset dates through July 26 with hospitalization data. Together these sources cover: disease, country, subnational_location (states named), date_reported, cases_confirmed, deaths, hospitalizations, source_url, source_type, and evidence_quote fields. Remaining gaps (cases_probable/suspected/locality granularity, FDA/FSIS advisory pages with case counts) are real but marginal — the iteration cap has been reached and the core evidentiary record is well-established. Further searching is not permitted under the bounds constraint.
